questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me pull a list of the accounts that have total order amounts over $2000? I'd love to also get the name of their district and the average age of the clients tied to those accounts.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'accounts' I mean the accounts that actually placed the orders – the ones from which the money is sent, not the ones that receive it.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT a.account_id,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date))/365.25) AS average_age
FROM account a
JOIN "order" o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A2
HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 2000

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'accounts' I mean the accounts that receive the money in the orders – the destination account numbers, not the ones that originated the payment.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    AVG((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25) AS average_age
FROM (
        SELECT "order".account_to AS account_id
        FROM "order"
        GROUP BY "order".account_to
        HAVING SUM("order".amount) > 2000
    ) AS o
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A2;

Can you show me their average monthly spending on these transfer transactions and rank them by total amount?

SELECT 
    d.client_id,
    AVG(t.amount) AS avg_monthly_spending
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1996'
    AND t.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'
GROUP BY d.client_id
